en.aboutMe: I'm a Salesforce Developer with 5 years of experience building stuff with Apex and Lightning Web Components. I'm the developer you rely on to keep systems stable, I like solving complex problems before they become emergencies. Whether it's modernizing legacy code, architecting scalable solutions, or implementing robust error handling, I'm all in. I had internships in Germany and Austria through IAESTE, which taught me to adapt quickly and think on my feet.
en.beyondCode: I also like to take pictures while traveling abroad and playing some violin or viola if I'm feeling like it, I've done it since I was 7 so it's kind of a comfort zone for me. I consider myself half engineer and half artist.
